split-squat.criteria: Fixed split stance, neutral-grip dumbbells by sides, bend both knees and rise through front foot. Rear knee hovers instead of source floor-touch variation.

front-foot-elevated-split-squat.criteria: Front foot fully supported on low platform, rear toes on floor, dumbbells at sides. Fixed stance with controlled descent and ascent; front leg has greater flexion than level-floor version.

deficit-reverse-lunge.criteria: Begin with both feet on low platform, step right foot backward onto floor, lower with left foot planted on platform, return right foot onto platform. Dumbbells held at sides.

sourceKind: Original procedural motion; no copied imagery.
limits: Eight-second teaching cycle, left leg forward; repeat opposite side separately. Platform height one world unit (illustrative). Rear knee hovers. Procedural character, not captured human biomechanics. No phone or production verification.
